summary: States Handling Access to Reciprocity for Employment Act of 2026 or the SHARE Act of 2026 This bill requires the Federal Bureau of Investigation to provide criminal history record information to a state occupational or professional licensing authority for the purpose of conducting background checks on individuals seeking a license to practice in an interstate compact member state. (Such interstate compacts are agreements between states that streamline the process for someone with an occupational or professional license in one state to practice within other compact states.) A state licensing authority may not share criminal history record information with the compact's commission, any other state entity or licensing authority, or the public.
